capabilities: Jot quick text notes in a sidebar panel
Draw freehand on a canvas with adjustable brush color and size
Append selected text from any Markdown note via a context-menu option
Save scratchpad text and drawings to disk manually
extras: The README warns that content lives in memory and is lost when the app closes unless manually saved, and that only one scratchpad note is supported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in throwaway space for jotting quick ideas or sketches while working across notes without creating vault files.
summary: Sidebar scratchpad plugin that offers a text tab for quick temporary notes and a canvas tab for freehand drawing, with manual save to disk.
